title: Chateau Marmont: Somewhere & La La Land Hotel Guide
description: Chateau Marmont on Sunset Boulevard is the Hollywood hideaway from Sofia Coppola's Somewhere and the La La Land exteriors. History and how to stay.
h1: Chateau Marmont: Hollywood's castle on Sunset Boulevard
intro: Modelled on a French château, the Chateau Marmont has been a discreet retreat for people in the film business since 1929. It is a real hotel, and you can book it.
filming: Sofia Coppola filmed Somewhere here, with the hotel at the centre of the story of a movie star's aimless days. In La La Land (2016), the hotel's exterior is the place where Mia stays, although the film's interior scenes were reportedly shot elsewhere.
facts: The Chateau Marmont opened in 1929 as an apartment-hotel hybrid.
It was built to replicate the Château d'Amboise, a royal retreat in France's Loire Valley.
Hollywood producer Albert E. Smith purchased the hotel in 1929.
John Belushi died in a bungalow here in March 1982.
Shawn Levy's 2019 book The Castle on Sunset tells the hotel's history in detail.
visit: The hotel is on Sunset Boulevard in West Hollywood, close to restaurants and shops. Bungalows and garden rooms book out far ahead.
